text:
Bobby Brink came home to Minnesota in the trade that sent David Jiricek to Philadelphia, and Bill Guerin has talked about betting on him, as Michael Russo and Kevin Kurz wrote for The Athletic. So far the bet looks reasonable without looking like a win.

He has nine points in 19 games in under 14 minutes a night, only one goal on 3.4 expected (the quality of his chances), shooting 3.6% against a typical 10 to 15%. The Wild have 54% of the five-on-five expected goals with him on the ice. He's getting the looks and contributing to a 12-3-4 team; the goals are late.

Evolving-Hockey had him as a modest positive in Philadelphia last season, mostly on defense. His ice time is up a minute and a half over the last ten games, including 18 minutes against San Jose. Our projection sees about 13 goals. For a Minnesota kid on a contender, a few more of those chances going in would make this trade read very differently.
